concept.title: Older people and carers
concept.shortdesc: Older people, including those with dementia, and the unpaid carers and families who support them.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People described by age as older, typically over 55, 60, 65 or 75, including those with age-related frailty or conditions.
: People who have dementia or are affected by it, including those with advanced dementia.
: Services open to carers along with the family members and friends around them, often listed as a combined group, including young and young adult carers.
: Unpaid or informal carers described simply as carers, including foster carers, former carers and partners who care.
